doc: The planning night before each girl's first appearance (inventory 2.1/2.2) with the week's activity and the stat her touzyou check needs; the appearance day is the kernel rand's (rand % 3 per school day), so the milestone is the scene, not a day. Yumi's debut (96/4/4, fixed) is months.json m96_04.

covers: GIRL-01 Mio: humanities week, para_bun >= 55 (touzyou_check, rand % 3 per school day)
GIRL-04 Saki: any week, her home place != your club, para_kon >= 36

activity 7 (rest): with activity 0 Mio (para_bun >= 55) debuts first, and once two of girls 1..9 are met touzyou_check2 wants para_kon >= 96, so Saki never comes; a rand debut (touzyou_check: rand() % 3 per week): the long cycle takes the Dec 95 exam week's forced icon, the light row keeps the reference's trace under 64 MiB
GIRL-05 Yukari: sports week, Shiori's home place != 8, para_un and para_you >= 81
GIRL-06 Nozomi: sports week, Shiori's home place != 9, para_un and para_kon >= 31
GIRL-07 Mira: looks week; two of girls 1..9 met (Yuko, Mio) -> touzyou_check2, para_you >= 126
GIRL-08 Yuko: stage 3 done (flags bits 9..11 = 3), misc. week, para_zat >= 91 -> stage 4, met
GIRL-09 Megumi: New Year shrine, unmet, tokimeki base >= 20, odd frame (rand-like)
